inlines.v: HAND'ED, participle passive Given or transmitted by the hands; conducted; furled. HAND'ED, adjective With hands joined. 1. In composition, as right-handed, most dextrous or strong with the right hand; having the right hand most able and ready. Left-handed, having the left hand most strong and convenient for principal use.
